_readme: Provenance manifest for every fee/threshold fact centralized in lib/readiness/constants.ts and src/data/visa-fees.json / visa-details.json. Added per the fee/threshold truth-audit task. NOTE: data/knowledge/ (the official-source snapshot folder) is not present in this repo/environment (it is explicitly gitignored -- see .gitignore's 'chatbot training knowledge base ... never commit' entry) -- every 'source' field below that says 'needs human verification' means exactly that: the value could not be checked against an official document from inside this environment, and was left as whatever the codebase already had (Phase 1 audit already reconciled the code's own internal disagreements; this manifest does not change any value beyond that unless a source is cited). Do not treat a 'needs human verification' source as a confirmed fact.

facts.description: Subclass 191 (from 491) income requirement: no minimum income; ATO notices of assessment for three income years out of the five years of the eligible visa
facts.source: data/knowledge/Permanent Residence (Skilled Regional) visa (subclass 191)/Permanent Residence (Skilled Regional) visa (subclass 191).pdf -- "Satisfy the income requirement": "There is no minimum income requirement. You must provide notices of assessment issued by the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) for three income years out of the five years of your eligible visa." (The document names subclass 491 and 494 as the eligible visas.) Replaces the former unsourced AUD 53,900/year threshold.

facts.description: Anmac Full skills assessment fee (nurses currently or previously registered as a nurse in Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, Singapore, Spain, the United Kingdom or the United States; midwives with a minimum Bachelor of Midwifery from Ireland, the UK or the US registered in that country)
facts.source: data/knowledge/Skill Assessments/Anmac/Anmac.pdf p.26 -- "Full skills assessment Apply for this assessment if you are registered as a nurse or midwife in an approved overseas country and meet the eligibility requirements below. ● Fee: $595 AUD ● Time to apply: 25 minutes (average, not including document preparation) ● Current wait time for assessment to start: 6–8 weeks". Nursing eligibility (p.26): "For nursing applicants To qualify for a Full skills assessment, you must: ● hold a relevant nursing qualification ● be current or previously registered as a nurse in one of the following countries: ● Canada ● Hong Kong ● Ireland ● Singapore ● Spain ● United Kingdom ● United States. If your qualification is not a Bachelor of Nursing from Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, the United Kingdom or the United States, you must also: ● have completed a qualification that led to general nursing registration after 1 January 2017 ● have successfully completed a regulatory examination process in one of the countries listed above (where applicable) ● have completed at least 1,800 hours of paid registered nurse work experience since 1 January 2017 in that same country." (extracted by scripts/generate-anmac-fees.ts into src/data/health-registration/anmac-fees.json).
